Landscape renovations in Greater Baton Rouge and surrounding areas

Overgrown or dated beds rebuilt with new plants, mulch, edging and a better layout — with a written scope and same-day response.

Request an estimate Call (225) 324-8252
The problem

Overgrown beds make a home look dated.

On established properties, foundation shrubs outgrow their beds, bed lines soften, and the whole house reads older than it is. A renovation resets the bones - not just the plants. Bed lines matter more than plant count for how a house looks from the street.

What changes the size of a renovation: bed square footage, plant size at install, removal volume, and access for equipment.

What's included
  • ✓Demolition and removal of tired plant material
  • ✓Soil and bed preparation
  • ✓Edging and bed-line reshaping
  • ✓Plant selection for South Louisiana heat and clay
  • ✓Mulch or pine straw finish
  • ✓After-care instructions
Landscape Renovations

Every property is different. Your scope depends on size, materials, accessibility, service frequency, and project scope. Free consultations and customized written estimates are always available.

What affects your estimate
  • Bed square footage
  • Plant size at install

Questions

Landscape Renovations FAQs

How much does a landscape renovation cost?
Every renovation is scoped to the property. What it takes depends on bed size, plant material and access - we put a clear written estimate in your hands before any work starts.
Do you remove the old plants?
Yes - demolition and removal of tired plant material is part of the written scope.
How long does a renovation take?
Most residential front-bed renovations are completed in one to three days once scheduled.
What plants hold up in Baton Rouge summers?
We select plant material for South Louisiana heat and clay, and give you after-care instructions so it establishes well.
Do you maintain what you install?
We do - many renovation clients move onto an annual property maintenance agreement.
